sourcePolicy: Curated published notice, never a live bridge opening feed

notices.source: U.S. Coast Guard Great Lakes District, Local Notice to Mariners 37/2026, Cleveland Harbor, PDF p. 5
notices.scheduledWorkDescription: The September 2026 Coast Guard notice schedules a fixed barge in the Eagle Avenue drawspan and removal work from January 18 through March 4, 2027. It does not establish the bridge's current opening state.
notices.background: Federal rulemaking described Eagle Avenue as long held in the raised position and slated for removal. It is not an ordinary active drawbridge-opening viewpoint.
